Keep the child's arm and finger separate from their torso and oriented across the gap toward the far ball. The defining idea is indicating THAT faraway object as opposed to this nearby object. No words, no speech bubbles, no arrows, no pointers added as graphics.
assets.selfReviewNotes: 远处红球与近处蓝球形成明确对比；孩子的目光与手势朝向远处目标。草地填充偏满，暖白留白比预期少，需小尺寸盲审。
